from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPSResult(BaseModel):
    """Diluted earnings per share reported in one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company, as stated in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities code of the company")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share value for the period")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the EPS, e.g. '元/股'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this EPS covers, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    category_note: str | None = Field(description="Optional note about the value range relative to task thresholds")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_results: list[CompanyEPSResult]
